description.en: Creates the bust-up picture of a character (CMND_CREATE_BUSTUP(_mdlHdl, _name)) and places it: at [5, 66, 0] when _right is true (the default), at [323, 66, 0] otherwise. Returns the picture's handle.
Name of the picture object (the helpers use the character's name followed by 顔).
true for the position [5, 66, 0], false for [323, 66, 0].

examples.case: A bust-up for a character (real usage, from ev42010600.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
